Armor

Armor can be equipped at the Armory or in a Hellpod on the Bridge before Missions in Helldivers 2.

Contents

  • 1 Acquisition
  • 2 Armory
  • 3 Armor Stats
  • 4 Media
  • 5 Change History

Acquisition

Most armor sets can be acquired by unlocking them through Warbonds with Medals or buying them from the Superstore using Super Credits.

Armory

ArmorHelmetCape

Body armors come with designated armor passive abilities and specific stats; they are categorized into light, medium, and heavy types.

There are a total of 30 light, 49 medium, and 29 heavy armors.

LightMediumHeavy

Light armor enhances mobility with minimal protection.

Armor Stats

Armors have three primary stats: 

• Armor Rating : Represents the armor's ability to absorb damage.
• Speed        : Determines how quickly the Helldiver can move across the battlefield.
• Stamina Regen: Affects the regeneration of stamina, which is used when sprinting and performing other strenuous actions.


Armor rating increases or reduces damage taken using the following formulas: 

• If Armor Rating ≤ 150
  ◦ Damage taken = Attack Damage × (1.5 - (Armor Rating ÷ 200))
• If Armor Rating ≥ 150
  ◦ Damage taken = Attack Damage × (1.05 - (Armor Rating ÷ 500))


Speed is calculated based on the raw Armor Rating stat (before factoring in passives like Extra Padding) using the following formula: 

• Speed = 600 − Armor Rating

Stamina Regen is similarly calculated using these formulas: 

• If Armor Rating ≥ 100
  ◦ Stamina Regen = 200 − Armor Rating
• If Armor Rating < 100
  ◦ Stamina Regen = 150 − Armor Rating ÷ 2

Change History

Patch
Description

1.001.104
2024-10-15

Changes

  • Helldiver armor tweaks
    • Both Heavy and Light armor are now more effective,
    • Heavy armor reduces damage taken by 25%, up from 20%
      • 5% more damage reduction
  • Light armor increases damage taken by 25%, down from 33%
    • 8% less damage taken

Note: These changes actually apply to Heavy and Light armor's default armor values of 150 and 50 respectively, not the type of armor itself.

1.000.400
2024-06-13

Fix

  • Fixed a bug where the Helldivers armor could appear invisible for other players.

1.000.300
2024-04-29

Change

  • Armors with armor rating above 100 now also reduce damage on headshots.

1.000.200
2024-04-02

Changes

  • Heavy and medium armor protects better and you now take about 10% less damage than before while wearing heavy and about 5% less when wearing medium armor. Fortified commando and light armor is unchanged.
  • Helldiver limbs explosion damage reduction increased from 0% to 100%.

Undocumented Change

  • Helldiver chest explosion damage reduction increased to 50%.

1.000.100
2024-03-06

Fix

  • Fixed armor rating values not reducing damage as intended.
